title: Rubric amendment
description: The rule a human override implies. A pick teaches the system one bit and evaporates; an induced, ratified rule applies to every later comparison. This document is a proposal only — nothing enters a rubric until the owner ratifies it by editing the rubric file themselves.

rule.description: One explicit, rankable rule, phrased so the owner can ratify it by reading it alone.

rationale.description: Why this rule, and not another, explains the override.

slots_after.description: The existing criterion this rule should follow in precedence, when the inducer has a view.

conflicts.description: Existing criteria this rule would fight with. Naming them is what makes ratification informed rather than rubber-stamped.
